items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I think I brought along my college roommate Johnny Seicher who liked jazz.

ctx.x: what was the out of the tea room that was a private party that was a fraternity party thank you you

somebody let probably Greenwood know and they checked and they said whether we could come or not and they said sure come on. So we did. Well I think I brought along my college roommate Johnny Seicher who liked jazz. Is he showing any of the photos? Yeah he's in one of the Smoking a Seagull? Oh no. He's not one of us. He was obviously listening to the band. Yeah he was the first one. Johnny was the one who told me about the New Orleans Record Show. First place I heard about it. First person I heard about it from.…

Let's see. His notes if I'm reading them right I'll have to go back and check the journal on this. Greenwood? Yeah. He talks about Chapatulis and Napoleon. Herb Moran was at Campbell's. He's not there anymore and the date I believe is the 10th of December 1949. That's his entry. Yeah that's his entry. He's not there anymore. And uh I read this to you yesterday or a few days ago.
